banner.title: Senior Software Engineer
banner.description: Senior Software Engineer with 10+ years of experience building scalable web and mobile applications with React, React Native, Next.js, and TypeScript across fintech, food-tech, enterprise SaaS, and e-commerce. Full-stack capable (Node.js, NestJS, PostgreSQL, AWS), driving front-end architecture, mentoring developers, and shipping production software in Agile teams.

introduction.heading: Professional Introduction
paragraphs: I'm a Senior Software Engineer with 10+ years of experience building scalable web and mobile applications across fintech, food-tech, enterprise SaaS, and e-commerce.
I delivered an ordering platform for a major Philippine fast-food brand serving 500,000+ users and 10,000+ daily transactions, and built a shared component library adopted by four engineering teams.
highlights: Frontend: React.js, Next.js, TypeScript, JavaScript (ES6+), Redux Toolkit, RTK Query, Micro-Frontends, Tailwind CSS, Styled Components, Material UI, Ant Design
Mobile: React Native (CLI), iOS and Android app releases
Backend: Node.js, NestJS, Express, FastAPI, GraphQL, REST APIs, C#
Databases: PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, MongoDB, DynamoDB, Redis
Cloud & DevOps: AWS Lambda, API Gateway, Docker, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD
Testing & Quality: Jest, Vitest, React Testing Library, Cypress, Code Reviews
Auth & Realtime: OAuth2, OpenID Connect, WebSockets
AI & Computer Vision: Claude API, YOLO, OpenCV

experiences.description: Delivered the customer-facing ordering and marketing platform for one of the Philippines' largest fast-food brands.
responsibilities: Served 500,000+ registered users across 300+ stores, processing 10,000+ daily transactions.
Designed and built a shared React component library adopted by four engineering teams, speeding up feature delivery by 20%.
Partnered with engineering leadership on the technical roadmap, front-end architecture decisions, and Agile delivery improvements.
Strengthened production stability through code reviews, performance optimization, and front-end architecture refactors; mentored developers on React and TypeScript practices.

experiences.description: Built core features for a mobile-first social networking platform using React, TypeScript, and Node.js.
responsibilities: Resolved 20+ front-end and API integration issues, significantly reducing post-release defects.
Standardized reusable UI components and design patterns, improving consistency and reducing QA-reported UI defects.
Built analytics dashboards and reporting features for product stakeholders.

experiences.description: Delivered React and TypeScript features for enterprise e-commerce and insurance platforms, meeting 100% of sprint commitments.
responsibilities: Integrated payment gateways and third-party insurance APIs with resilient retry and error-handling strategies.
Diagnosed and resolved production incidents across front end, backend APIs, and database layers, working with architects and backend engineers to improve reliability.

Architected and built a full-featured CRM platform (React, Node.js, NestJS, PostgreSQL) covering booking, quotations, job scheduling, employee management, timekeeping, and reporting, with role-based access control.
Integrated third-party CRM and logistics APIs to automate workflows and improve data consistency, reducing support requests.
Owned production support for critical business modules with zero client escalations throughout the engagement.
Independently designed and delivered a community platform connecting 500+ dog owners and walkers in six weeks.
Maintained and enhanced POS, inventory, and hotel management systems.
Conducted code reviews for the development team, achieving zero critical production defects across multiple release cycles.
Delivered custom web applications and POS systems for retail and utility businesses using PHP, MySQL, and C#.
